comparison.objective: Receive a terminal block safely from a person and press-latch it onto a DIN rail; candidate adjusts and locks an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Handover task tests compliant acquisition from a held object, human-contact force limiting, precise rail alignment, and snap insertion. Candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, fastener release, fine rotary tuning, tightening, and repeated response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal block must be cleanly handed over and latched within submillimetric rail tolerances while respecting 5 N/10 N hand-contact limits and avoiding drops or rail motion. Candidate instead requires two safe, repeatable impacts and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both use force control and a retention mechanism, but compliant handover plus snap mounting is a different tested ability from adjustable damping and post-adjustment lock verification.
